posts.en:
qcc-mcp-oauth is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. One-click OAuth (PKCE) connect to Qichacha (qcc.com) MCP services in DeepSeek Harness: dynamic client registration, token auto-refresh, and dynamic mcp-client configuration.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-9f38fae6b197cb1afb05.html
